```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- readRDS("data/imdb_snapshots.rds") |> as_tibble()
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
snap_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
snap_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

scrape_snapshot <- function(url, snap_year) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      page <- request(url) |>
        req_timeout(60) |>
        req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 5) |>
        req_perform() |>
        resp_body_html()

      tbl <- page |>
        html_element("table") |>
        html_table()

      tooltip <- page |>
        html_elements("td strong") |>
        html_attr("title")

      tbl |>
        select(rank_title_year = `Rank & Title`, rating = `IMDb Rating`) |>
        mutate(
          rank_title_year = str_replace_all(rank_title_year, "\n +", " "),
          rank = str_extract(rank_title_year, "^\\d+") |> as.integer(),
          title = str_remove(rank_title_year, "^\\d+\\.\\s+") |>
            str_remove("\\s+\\(\\d{4}\\)\\s*$"),
          year = str_extract(rank_title_year, "\\((\\d{4})\\)\\s*$", group = 1) |> as.integer(),
          rating = as.numeric(rating),
          number = str_extract(tooltip, "[0-9][0-9,]*(?= votes)") |>
            str_remove_all(",") |>
            as.integer(),
          snap_year = snap_year
        ) |>
        select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("The Wayback Machine refused or could not complete the request.")
      tibble(
        snap_year = integer(),
        rank = integer(),
        title = character(),
        year = integer(),
        rating = numeric(),
        number = integer()
      )
    }
  )
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snap_urls, snap_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(snap_year, title, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015) |>
  left_join(
    imdb_snapshots |>
      distinct(title, year),
    by = "title"
  ) |>
  mutate(decade = floor(year / 10) * 10)

rank_changes |>
  slice_max(abs(rank_change), n = 10)

rank_changes |>
  group_by(decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(decade)
```

```{r}
snapshot_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, snap_year) |>
  count(title, name = "snapshot_count")

snapshot_counts |>
  count(snapshot_count, name = "film_count")
```

```{r}
rank_changes |>
  group_by(decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(avg_rank_change < 0, "Rose", "Fell"),
    decade = factor(decade, levels = sort(unique(decade)))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = fct_rev(decade), fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rose" = "#2E8B57", "Fell" = "#C44E52")) +
  labs(
    title = "IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Average change from 2015 to 2022; negative values indicate a rise in rank",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 rank - 2015 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Direction",
    caption = "Based on 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
